notes: All 25 candidates are not-a-list; no program-list or single-record pages in this chunk. Institutions by host were kept for every page. The UTEP PhD academic-placements page (2019 capture) is the only placement page: it names about 40 hiring institutions for the College of Business doctoral program without graduate names or years, so it is unusable as a graduate list but could support a program-level placement note. The two upf.edu/fundacio alumni captures are empty. Several McCombs 'Alumni' pages are undergraduate (BBA/BHP), master's (MSTC) or student-organization pages; the UTD IMS page is an admissions page despite its 'phd-applicants-and-candidates' address.
